node_1.subject: Bernard Lowe
node_1.description: This is Bernard Lowe's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00am, walk to Hobbs cafe and open up for the day at 7:30am, work at Hobbs cafe from 8:00am to 4:00pm, have dinner at 8:00pm, go to bed at 11:00pm.
